entities.summary: The Ahmed Baba Institute, officially the Ahmed Baba Institute of Higher Learning and Islamic Research, is a library and research centre in Timbuktu. The centre was founded in 1973, with financing primarily from Kuwait. It was named after 17th-century Timbuktu scholar Ahmad Baba al Massufi. Ahmed Baba Institute is a research center in Africa, established in 1973. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
